title: Adopting Embedded AI Through an Innovation Team
abstract: arXiv:2611.25939v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software organizations are increasingly embedding AI capabilities into products that existing teams already own and maintain, but how this development work should be organized is not well understood. We conducted a qualitative case study of a temporary cross-functional innovation team in a large Norwegian financial organization, drawing on 18 interviews with 15 participants, 10 days of office observation, observations of ten meetings, and internal documents. We found that structural separation, AI competence inside the team, high autonomy within a clear mandate, senior expertise, and flexible ways of working enabled the team to explore and build embedded AI solutions. While structural separation enabled this work, it also made adoption dependent on coordination with the permanent product team that would own the solution. translated_title: 通过创新团队采纳嵌入式AI
translated_abstract: 软件组织正日益将AI能力嵌入到由现有团队拥有和维护的产品中，但这类开发工作应如何组织尚不明确。我们对挪威一家大型金融机构中一个临时性的跨职能创新团队开展了定性案例研究，研究基于对15名参与者的18次访谈、10天的办公室实地观察、对十次会议的观察以及内部文档分析。我们发现，结构上的分离、团队内部的AI能力、在明确授权范围内的高度自主性、资深专家的参与以及灵活的工作方式，使该团队能够探索并构建嵌入式AI解决方案。虽然结构分离促成了这项工作，但它也使采纳落地依赖于与最终拥有该解决方案的常设产品团队之间的协调。而路线图不一致、优先级差距以及缺乏同地办公，制约了这种协调。我们识别出七项……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 通过对挪威一家大型金融机构的定性案例研究发现，拥有结构分离、团队内AI能力、明确授权下高自主性、资深专家和灵活工作方式的临时跨职能创新团队能够成功构建嵌入式AI解决方案，但其采纳落地依赖于与常设产品团队的协调，而路线图错位、优先级分歧和缺乏同地办公会阻碍这一协调。
en_tdlr: A qualitative case study of a large Norwegian financial organization shows that a temporary cross-functional innovation team—enabled by structural separation, in-team AI competence, high autonomy under a clear mandate, senior expertise, and flexible ways of working—can successfully build embedded AI solutions, but adoption ultimately depends on coordination with the permanent product team, which is constrained by misaligned roadmaps, prioritization gaps, and a lack of co-location.
